judgement.reason: SFTPGo serves an HTTP web client and WebDAV, and settings can move storage to S3 and the database to PostgreSQL or MySQL, so contained changes are enough.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported storage: the app declares durable local state (users_base_dir = /srv/sftpgo/data (Dockerfile)) with no VOLUME or Compose mount. Deployz provides object storage, not an attached data directory.
reviews.reason: The production Dockerfile sets users_base_dir to /srv/sftpgo/data for user files, and no shown setting selects S3 for that data, so durable local storage appears to be required.
